outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE standalone landscape 16:9 cinematic empty environment still, no collage, no people or animals. Reference image 1 is the approved Lei Ting trading office, authoritative for ALL architecture, furniture, prop design and daylight. Preserve this exact room, not a redesign. Dark teal inset shelves on back wall with gold eel sculpture, books and minerals; double dark wood brass-inlaid doors on right wall; arched ocean window on left wall; curved walnut trading desk with three monitors and ONE black ergonomic chair on camera-facing operator side; rug, teal sofa sitting area on original camera side. Maintain all relative positions. High-end feature-film CGI, physically based materials, crisp wood grain, brushed brass, soft coastal daylight, warm ceiling strips, natural contact shadows, restrained reflections, no plastic sheen or excessive blur. Abstract cyan/amber charts only, no readable text. Camera in the operator area beside the ergonomic chair, looking RIGHT toward the existing closed double entrance doors. Desk edge and edges/backs of monitor array in left foreground for spatial context; door with original brass lever is the main midground subject, dark teal shelves on left. Eye-level medium wide shot, 35mm. Do not move door onto shelf wall. No new furniture.
outputs.inspection: 桌窗柜门总体关系延续，陈设细节有生成偏差。
